name: @emsenn/computing
description: Computing — the theory of computing made operational, downstream of gaming. The corpus theorem: CGS IS the theory of computing. Where @emsenn/gaming carries the CGS structures, this package makes CGS operate: categorifying builds the executable *-autonomous category, cartesianizing builds the Kleisli sub-CCC, restricting realizes paradigm subcategory membership, operating runs the settled-information->observation->arena->strategy->move computer, and encoding carries the representation boundary.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.build.json && chmod +x dist/scripts/*.mjs
scripts.rebuild: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build
